cue.heading: The review bar and the transfer provision

compare.title: Place of imprisonment
compare.text: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, a designation of a place of imprisonment under this subsection <mark>is not reviewable by any court</mark>.

compare.title: First Step Act time credits
compare.text: The Director of the Bureau of Prisons <mark>shall transfer eligible prisoners</mark>, as determined under section 3624(g), into prerelease custody or supervised release.
